authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: We evaluate AI investing products through reproducible, published back-testing methodologies.

editorial.how_we_test: Every tool we review undergoes rigorous back-testing against historical market data. We publish the full methodology so results can be independently verified.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We may earn an affiliate commission when you purchase tools through our links. This does not affect our testing methodology or results.
editorial.corrections: We correct factual errors promptly and transparently. Corrections are noted at the bottom of the affected article.
